faq.q: Does Cadence work with Zoom and Google Meet recordings?
faq.a: Yes. Cadence imports recordings directly from Zoom, Google Meet, and Riverside, or you can upload a local file. Speaker splitting happens automatically on arrival.
Yes — transcripts export as plain text or SRT files, and every line stays linked to its timestamp in the original recording.

faq.q: Is there a limit to how many people can co-edit?
faq.a: The Free plan supports 1 editor seat, Team supports up to 5, and Studio has no seat limit. All co-editors see the same live waveform in real time.

faq.q: What happens if I go over my free episode limit?
faq.a: You'll get a heads-up in-app before you hit the limit, with an easy option to upgrade to Team for unlimited episodes.
Yes — there's no lock-in contract on any plan. Cancel anytime from your account settings and keep access until the end of your billing period.
